results.notes: Australian (from "enraptured"). Peak use was the 1980s-90s; still common, a little older-sounding than "stoked". Often spelt "wrapped". Predicative only ("I'm rapt", "rapt with it"); before a noun it reads as general English "engrossed" ("rapt attention").

Surf slang shared with the US (earliest Wiktionary quote is Australian surfing, 1964). Fully current in Australia and probably the commonest word for "thrilled". Predicative ("stoked with it", "stoked to hear").

args.text:
G'day, and welcome aboard. You've just joined a cracker of a crew doing work that'll fair knock your socks off.

We've got a once-in-a-lifetime shot at dragging the government into the digital age and changing the way it runs. That chance is what brings us all together, and it's what keeps us fired up about the work we do.

The people you'll be working with here are a seriously talented, hard-working bunch, and they genuinely give a stuff about making a difference. You'll find the culture's strong: everyone's welcome, nothing's hidden, people treat each other right, and the mood's pretty upbeat.

Part of your job is being a top-notch partner to our colleagues right across government. We're not just out to lead the way on tech; we want to show what a modern, pitch-in-together, all-sorts-welcome culture looks like. How well we work with people across government makes or breaks how much difference we can make.

We try to keep one eye on the big picture and the other on the job in front of us: always keeping that bigger opportunity front of mind, but keeping our feet on the ground with the nitty gritty of actually getting particular projects done. We're dead set on working in a way that's open, takes it a step at a time, and is built around the people who'll use it, with a big focus on actually delivering the goods.

We want the organisation itself to be as nimble and user-focused as our projects, drawing on everyone's ideas and know-how. So if you spot a way we could do better, give us a yell.

Thanks again for bringing your talents to serving the public. We're stoked to have you on the TTS team.
